figurative_meaning_en: More than fifty castes of Hindu-Bengalis according to varna distinctions
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাংলার সমাজে ছত্রিশ জাতের মানুষ একসাথে বাস করে।
এই বিবাহে ছত্রিশ জাতের লোক এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: In Bengali society, people from thirty-six castes live together.
People from thirty-six castes attended this wedding.
history: Refers to the traditional caste divisions in Hindu-Bengali society, derived from the ancient varna system in Hinduism, which categorized society into Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras, further subdividing into numerous jatis over time.
note: This expression highlights the diversity and complexity of the caste system in historical Bengal.
